mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and reduced corporate earnings power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained unemployment above 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annualized growth for three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annualized growth < 2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL growth below 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in industrial production above 3% month-over-month signals restrictive monetary policy coinciding with supply-side weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND INDPRO falls > 3% month-over-month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and INDPRO declines above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the civilian labor force participation rate above 62.5% for three consecutive months signals a tighter labor market and upward wage pressure, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained UNRATE above 62.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal income (GDPC1) above 4% annualized growth for three consecutive quarters signals stronger household balance sheets and higher consumption, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 4% for 3 consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 growth above 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 3% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals strengthening manufacturing activity and higher corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 3% month-over-month for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO growth above 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above 5% month-over-month signals accommodative monetary policy coinciding with stronger household savings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls AND RSAFS rises > 5% month-over-month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of simultaneous FEDFUNDS declines and RSAFS increases above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
